claims.value: Dayhoff is a hybrid state-space Mamba and Transformer self-attention architecture with Mixture-of-Experts modules. It is trained for protein sequence generation, mutation effect prediction, and scaffold design. The model supports long contexts and order-agnostic infilling via autoregressive training in N→C and C→N directions.
claims.evidence: The Dayhoff architecture is a hybrid of state-space Mamba layers and Transformer self-attention, interleaved with Mixture-of-Experts modules to maximize capacity while preserving efficiency. It natively handles long contexts... Trained with an autoregressive objective in both N→C and C→N directions, Dayhoff supports order-agnostic infilling
